A '''[[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]]''' was an associate of the space [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Rav]]. In [[137 ABY]], the Zabrak was present on [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]] when Rav offered [[Cade Skywalker]] a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on a "local pest" on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]]. The Zabrak attacked Cade after witnessing Cade [[Death/Legends|kill]] Rav's other [[Unidentified Kajain'sa'Nikto Pirate|associate]].<ref name="SWL 43" />

==Equipment==
The Zabrak wore black [[Boot/Legends|boots]] and a [[Armor/Legends|chestplate]]. They wielded a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and a [[Sword/Legends|sword]].<ref name="SWL 43" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Zabrak first appeared in the [[Legacy (2006) 43|forty-third issue]] of the [[2006]] [[Star Wars Legends|legends]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''. The comic was written by [[John Ostrander]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[December 23]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/16-142/Star-Wars-Legacy-43----Vongspawn|text=Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 43}}</ref>
